intent: Generate a bounded CapCut Agent scaffold for Tooensure-LLC.
acceptance: orchestrator, independent checker, and reflector agents exist
every generated skill surface has agents, scripts, references, assets, tests, and prompts
public agent identity is distinct from the governed PMCR-O package
planned capabilities carry explicit status and authority

default export-guide output is deterministic for a slow Ollama model

provenance and parent-child relationship are recorded
trail validator passes with an unexecuted next seed
